STATE OF NEW JERSEY

In the Matter of
COUNTY OF MORRIS,
Respondent,
-and- Docket No. IA-2026-005
PBA LOCAL 327,
Appellant/Union.
SYNOPSIS
The Public Employment Relations Commission affirms an
interest arbitration award that was remanded in P.E.R.C. No.
2021-43, 47 NJPER 468 (¶110 2021) for the arbitrator to clarify
and address the N.J.S.A. 34:13A-16g factors as to the award’s
dismissal of the PBA’s increased workday/ workweek proposal. For
the Remand Award, the PBA submitted a letter to the arbitrator
providing further argument in support of its increased workday/
workweek proposal, and the County submitted a brief in response.
The arbitrator then issued the Remand Award addressing the
remanded issues. The County submitted a supplementary brief
concurring with the Remand Award, and the PBA did not file a
supplementary brief.
This synopsis is not part of the Commission decision. It
has been prepared for the convenience of the reader. It has been
neither reviewed nor approved by the Commission.

DECISION
On March 26, 2026 we remanded an interest arbitration award
(Award) between the County of Morris (County) and PBA Local 327
(PBA). P.E.R.C. No. 2021-43, 47 NJPER 468 (¶110 2021). On
remand, we asked the arbitrator to provide clarification and
application of the N.J.S.A. 34:13A-16g factors as to the Award’s
analysis of the PBA’s “Final Offer Number 8”, which sought an
increase from a 7.5-hour workday and 37.5-work week to an 8-hour
workday and 40-hour work week.
On April 9, 2026, the PBA submitted a letter to the
arbitrator providing further argument in support of its increased
workday/workweek proposal. On April 10, the County submitted a
response to the PBA’s April 9 submission to the arbitrator. The

P.E.R.C. NO. 2026-44 2.
arbitrator considered both of the parties’ submissions in
addition to the documentary evidence and arguments previously
submitted in rendering the remand award.
On April 23, 2026, the arbitrator issued a 26-page remand
award (Remand Award) clarifying the Award’s dismissal of the
PBA’s increased workday/workweek proposal, and discussing in
detail the documentary evidence and testimony supporting his
decision. Pursuant to the Commission’s Order in P.E.R.C. No.
2021-43, the parties were given fourteen days from the issuance
of the Remand Award to file supplementary briefs. On May 11, the
County submitted its supplementary brief concurring with the
arbitrator’s clarification and requesting that the Commission
affirm the Remand Award. The PBA did not file a supplementary
brief.
Given the arbitrator’s amended explanation in the Remand
Award as to why the PBA’s increased workday/workweek proposal was
dismissed, and the PBA’s lack of opposition to the Remand Award,
we affirm the Award as amended by the Remand Award.
ORDER
The Award, as amended by the Remand Award, is affirmed.
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
Chair Hennessy-Shotter, Commissioners Davey, Higgins, and Hines
all voted in favor of this decision. Commissioner Papero recused
himself. Commissioner Eaton was not present.
ISSUED: May 28, 2026
Trenton, New Jersey
